title: Python: DTN S-flag HBH option (0x03) ingress parity
description: Consumer follow-up from vectors bead 7mgm, python side: python/src/lichen/routing/router.py has DTN buffering (MAX_DTN_TTL_SECONDS, dtn_buffer) but no IPv6 hop-by-hop Type=0x03 DTN option parsing (S-flag 0x80 + absolute expiry u32 BE, spec/05-routing.md 9.8). Implement per test/vectors/dtn_sflag_hbh.json (dtn_hbh cases) with the R-05-080 clockless fail-open rule, consuming the vectors in a python test. C reference: lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/router.c IPV6_HBH_OPT_DTN path.
close_reason: Python DTN S-flag HBH option ingress parity: new python/src/lichen/routing/dtn_option.py (parse_dtn_option walking HBH option TLVs — PAD1/PADN skip, exactly one Type=0x03 with len 5, S flag 0x80 with reserved-ignored, expiry u32 BE, zero-expiry sentinel rejected for C parity) + decide_expiry_action (R-05-080 clockless fail-open: drop only when wall clock valid and expiry < now, strict boundary). Tests python/tests/test_dtn_option.py consume test/vectors/dtn_sflag_hbh.json (7 vectors: all dtn_hbh + dtn_semantic cases) plus implementation-pinned unit checks (duplicate, truncated, zero-expiry sentinel, boundary) explicitly labeled as such per reviewer. Full python suite green (816 tests incl. vector schema gate). Reviews: pass1-3 via kimi-k3 found 3 findings — zero-expiry check accidentally dropped by a comment edit (caught by the suite, restored), spec-silent choices mislabeled as vector-backed (relabeled implementation-pinned), dangling R-05-080 id (replaced with spec-section citation) — all fixed. Remaining: wire parse_dtn_option into node.py ingress (no production DTN call site exists yet) — same wiring gap as Rust/ beads; left documented.
